title: So who else saw one of the early screenings tonight?  What did we thi...
transcript: I have now seen wicked for good, so here are all of my non spoiler thoughts if you are just wondering if this movie is good, it is good. I do think it addresses some of the issues in actual wicked, although not all of them, and overall provides a very satisfying conclusion to the story. They definitely deviate a lot more from the stage show in part two than they did in part one. They've added a ton of new music, not just the two new songs they already announced, and I'd go as far as to say 30 to 40% of the score is new or changed in some way. I will say I didn't really love either of the two new original songs that they've already announced. That being a new solo for Elphaba called there's No Place like home and a new solo for Glinda called The Girl in the bubble. I think especially The Girl in the bubble feels really misplaced and really slows down the pacing of the film in a really climactic moment. I do think all of the praise being lavished at Ariana Grande's and Cynthia Erivo's performances is 100% warranted. I have seen some people say that Ariana Grande outshines Cynthia Erivo. I don't see it that way, and I think that Cynthia's no good deed is by far the highlight of the film. That being said, I do think Ariana Grande is giving an equally compelling performance. And all of The Oscar buzz is definitely warranted. And of course, the four good sequence is just everything you want it to be. I do think overall part 1 is probably a stronger film. But again, act one of the musical is a stronger act than an Act 2. So in some ways that kind of feels inevitable. But it is still a really great adaptation and despite its flaws, a really great movie that I think absolutely does justice to the source material.
reasoning: The reviewer clearly states the movie 'is good' and calls it 'a really great adaptation' that 'does justice to the source material,' indicating a positive recommendation despite noting some flaws with pacing and new songs.
